name: qaai-dataset-gen
description: Generate, ingest, validate, and human-review labelled eval datasets for the QAAI reviewer pipelines: author grounded records for the RTM / test-case / hazard rubrics or convert a completed review run into a dataset, check every row against the live Pydantic models, and correct both inputs and outputs in a browser editor with an append-only audit log of every change and reviewer note.
